plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and validate the UX of the Aurora Network privacy settings, interacting with all sub-pages and controls across both desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: The run will begin at the privacy overview hub, validating navigation via cards and the sidebar. It will systematically visit each of the four privacy surfaces: Default Audience, Tag Review, Past Post Visibility, and Muted Words. In each surface, the agent will exercise forms, lists, and bulk action controls to document the interactive state and check for usability issues, especially tap target sizes on mobile.
assumptions: As a local demo, some 'Save' or 'Apply' actions may only update local UI state or do nothing, rather than persisting to a backend.
The sidebar navigation remains consistent across all sub-pages.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets on sidebar links and action buttons (flagged in prescan).
Mobile responsiveness of complex lists (Tag review pending queue, Past posts timeline).
Interaction state of the 'Custom list' selector in the Default Audience page.
Bulk action behaviors in Past Posts and Tag Review.

phases.title: Hub Navigation & Layout
phases.objective: Verify the structure of the overview page and navigation pathways.
key_checks: Verify all 4 privacy cards link to the correct sub-pages.
Check that 'Change' links in the Snapshot panel navigate correctly.
Evaluate sidebar navigation accessibility and tap target sizes.
exit_criteria: All primary navigation links have been tested.

phases.title: Default Audience Configuration
phases.objective: Test the audience selection and custom list management.
key_checks: Interact with the radio group (Public, Friends, Custom list, Only me).
Attempt to trigger custom list creation or selection.
exit_criteria: Audience radio buttons and save actions have been exercised.

phases.title: Tag Review Interactions
phases.objective: Validate the queue management for pending tags.
key_checks: Test individual item actions ('Approve', 'Hide tag', 'Block user').
Check mobile layout of the tag queue items.
exit_criteria: Both bulk and individual tag review actions have been clicked.

phases.title: Past Post Visibility Adjustments
phases.objective: Test filtering and bulk editing of past posts.
key_checks: Change filters for 'All years' and 'Any audience'.
Change the audience dropdown for an individual past post.
Click the 'Apply to visible' button to test bulk application.
exit_criteria: Filters have been adjusted and visibility changes attempted.

phases.title: Muted Words Management
phases.objective: Test adding, removing, and configuring muted words.
key_checks: Type a new word into the input and attempt to add/save it.
Click the 'x' buttons to remove existing muted words.
Toggle the checkboxes under 'Where do these apply?'.
Click Import/Export buttons to check for dialogs or errors.
exit_criteria: Input, deletion, and scoping of muted words have been tested.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 5 HTML pages identified in the prescan.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise the primary form controls (radios, selects, inputs, buttons) on every settings page.
coverage_targets.mobile: Ensure all pages are viewed in mobile mode, specifically checking the usability of small tap targets flagged in the prescan.

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets. Document if these actually impede interaction on the mobile viewport.
